title: History museum to host paranormal investigation walking tour Oct. 23-24
excerpt: Are you ready to investigate the some spooky sites in historic Greeneville?
content:
Are you ready to investigate the some spooky sites in historic Greeneville?

The Greeneville-Greene County History Museum is gearing up to host The Greeneville Files, an immersive paranormal investigation through downtown Greeneville.

Participants can choose to participate in this four-hour walking tour either Friday. Oct. 23 or Saturday, Oct. 24. The investigation begins at 6:30 p.m. both nights.

Be a paranormal investigator for the night

“Guests will investigate three historic locations, learn how paranormal investigations are conducted, and explore these remarkable spaces after dark,” event organizers say. “This is not a ghost-story tour — it is an opportunity to participate in a real paranormal investigation.”

The experience includes about 25 minutes of walking divided throughout the evening.

“Guests will be invited to use EMF readers and dowsing rods at select locations and may take photographs or make video and audio recordings in search of possible evidence,” organizers explain. “Along the way, the group will stop at Full Throttle Kitchen for a meal and rest break.”

The journey will conclude with an exclusive hour-long investigation inside Greeneville’s historic Capitol Theatre.

“Guests should wear comfortable, closed-toe shoes and dress appropriately for a late-October evening,” organizers note. “Please remain aware of your surroundings and follow staff instructions throughout the tour.

“This experience offers a different way to explore local history... and perhaps discover what still lingers within it,” organizers add.

Tickets and pricing

The cost to participate is $70 for museum members or $75 for general public. This price includes a $15 voucher for a meal and drink at Full Throttle Kitchen. Additional drinks may be purchased separately from the attached Corner Garage Bar.

“Tickets must be purchased for a specific night. Please confirm that you select the correct date — Oct. 23 or Oct. 24 — when purchasing,” organizers say.

The Greeneville-Greene County History Museum is located at 101 W. McKee St., in downtown Greeneville. Hours are Tuesday through Saturday from 11 a.m. to 4 p.m.

Visit http://www.greenevillegreenecountyhistorymuseum.com or call 423-636-1558 for more details about the upcoming walking tour or to learn more about the history museum.
